name: The Show Must Go On
source:
Watch as Takuya Nakajima, a second year Japanese high school student, manages a secret society at his school.

Dubbing it "The Lackadaisical Club," he hosts some of the most influential and troublesome students in the school, providing them a place relax and reorient... before they return to tyrannize the student populace.

Oftentimes, the club becomes embroiled in conflict as the various club members compete for political power in the school. Takuya serves as the mediator on such occasions. Most recently, Izumi Mitsui (The Mad Scientist) has come down with a queer case of lovesickness, so strong it threatens to throw the tenuous peace into chaos.

And so, the rest of the club forms a conspiracy.... On which side will Takuya fall?

It's anyone's best guess. But no matter how the chips fall, The Show Must Go On!
translation:
看看日本高二学生Takuya Nakajima如何管理校内的秘密社团。

他将其命名为“悠哉社”，招来学校里最有影响力、也最麻烦的一些学生，给他们提供一个放松、调整状态的地方……然后，他们就又回去欺压其他学生了。

社员们争夺校内权力时，社团也时常陷入冲突。每逢这种时候，Takuya就会出面调解。最近，人称“疯狂科学家”的Izumi Mitsui患上了一场古怪的相思病，严重到足以让本就脆弱的和平彻底崩溃。

于是，其余社员联合策划了一场阴谋……Takuya会站在哪一边？

谁也说不准。不过，无论局势如何发展，好戏都得继续上演！
